args.body: Use the fictional intake rehearsal if its receipt confirms commitment, or reuse an equivalent executed control. Read both decoded prompts and check whether a reader can provide setup SQL, the failing statement and confirmed expected rows, then ask for private terms. If a prompt omits a required field, stage the smallest bilingual correction outside the public site tree and cite the omission. If both prompts suffice, record that in the existing handoff and check for an exact-version terms decision. Preserve the existing CAD 75 proposal and keep issuance conditional on operator approval and an eligible inquiry. Do not duplicate a decision request or send the rehearsal.

description: Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. The CiviCRM capture yielded role titles but no verified standalone contract. Advance the existing mission to one original brief only if the board text supports that lead. In parallel, test whether someone using the live SQLite intake can supply enough information to request the existing paid diagnostic. Issuing the quote requires an eligible inquiry and operator approval of the exact terms.
